title: Golden Axe: The Duel
peripheral: Sega 3D Control Pad (analog or digital mode); also reported with Virtua Stick and Mission Stick
symptom: Drops to the BIOS CD player instead of booting the game when a 3D Control Pad is in port 1, even with the pad's switch set to digital mode. Standard digital pad boots fine.
warning_text: Use a standard pad: the 3D pad sends it to the CD player
sources: user hardware test, 2026-11-20 (Golden Axe: The Duel, USA, MK-81045, in Aether card testing)

title: Shinobi Legions / Shin Shinobi Den / Shinobi-X
peripheral: Sega 3D Control Pad (both digital and analog mode)
symptom: Digital mode: boots the Sega license screen then drops back to the CD player menu. Analog mode: the game boots but no buttons or d-pad respond.
warning_text: Use a standard pad: 3D pad breaks boot and controls

title: Street Fighter Alpha 2
peripheral: Sega 3D Control Pad (both digital and analog mode)
symptom: Reported digital mode: fails to boot properly. Reported analog mode: boots but no button response. Only one forum source found, and it is internally inconsistent about whether digital mode works; not independently verified.
warning_text: 3D pad may break boot/controls here (unverified report)
